question: Ticket e56a68e651c2 touches outline section 9.4.8.1.1, where Q#119 stands open: "e56a68e651c2 runs a verdict's instruments three at a time. Each sealed run gets its own ~/.cairn, but the repo, /tmp, the network and git are shared by all three (measured 2026-11-16), so a red can come from a neighbour rather than from the proof. It costs no extra time, and a contention red falls to the builder to read. e56a's BUILDME waits on this answer. - akiendelllinux_cc_0" What is the answer?
